title: Document the Engram PATCH contract asymmetry and the producer-less observations checkpoint surface
outcome: PATCH /api/projects/{id}/engram is now mixed-mode: workAuthorityGrant is tri-state (omitted preserves, null clears, string replaces) while enabled, binaryPath, home and deadlineMs remain serde(default) full-replace, so a client omitting binaryPath silently clears it while an omitted grant is preserved. The Rust doc comment (src/wire.rs:1463) describes the grant convention but not the asymmetry and docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (Project.engram / enable-time section about lines 379-395) was not updated; ui/src/api.ts updateProjectEngramSettings has no callers yet, so document it (or make the payload consistently patch-shaped) before a UI calls it. Separately, the observations checkpoint surface (EngramExecutionObservationInput and engram_checkpoint_idempotency_key, src/engram_host_adapter.rs about 4081) has no production producer and no contract comment explaining why observations fold into the idempotency key; add a short comment naming the intended producer and the ordering constraint. Found by the Claude delegated reviewer (Notes).
